performance_case.causal_mechanism: Hash-bound structured reconciliation prevents a schema-valid but semantically misgrouped Local result from entering strategy specification or learning decisions.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance proves only offline evidence-quality tooling and exact closure of one sealed historical result. It proves no alpha, predictive value, PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value or activation authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero; the capability only reduces the risk that an invalid annual or path-risk conclusion influences later capital allocation research.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Five bounded files and one Local implementation cycle are spent to prevent repeated manual reconciliation and false research conclusions; forward evidence accumulation continues independently under the sole cloud clock.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Machine-checkable target-year rows, partition totals, evidence text and disposition bindings reduce evidence defects and learning latency before any matched-capital strategy experiment is allowed.
